// WHAT THIS IS: The ONE config file for src/orchestration. Three sections: `assets` (which modules load, grouped and gated), `partitions` (which sub-modules each partitioned asset offers), and `run` (the config the trading_view_full_refresh job carries). Replaced assets_enabled.json + tv_full_refresh.yaml on 2026-08-05.
// ABSENT MEANS OFF: Changed 2026-08-05, and it is the opposite of what this file used to do. Nothing loads unless it says true. The friendly default -- absent = on -- is the one under which a 777-ticker scrape or a 2.4-hour OCR parse joins a run because nobody wrote a line about it.
// EVERY MODULE MUST BE LISTED: Because absent is off, an asset missing from this file would vanish from the UI with nothing saying so. The loader RAISES on any asset in the graph that has no entry here, so adding an asset forces a yes or no.
// HIERARCHY: THE GROUP GATE: Each group is an object holding `enabled` plus its modules. A module loads only if BOTH its group's `enabled` and its own value are true, so one line switches off a whole layer while every module stays visible. Same rule as switch_config.json, where every ancestor must be true. A bare `"cafef": false` is REJECTED - write `"cafef": {"enabled": false, ...}` so the modules remain listed.
// COMMENTS: Any key starting with // is a comment and is ignored, the same convention switch_config.json uses. JSON has no comment syntax; this is the substitute.
// A TYPO IS AN ERROR: A key naming no asset and no partition RAISES at load time, listing the valid ones. A silently-ignored key is the exact failure switch_config.json's trailing-slash bug had: the file said a thing was off, the loader never matched it, and it ran anyway.
// PARTITIONS ARE SUB-MODULES: A partition that is not true is REMOVED from the asset's PartitionsDefinition: it cannot be materialized, cannot be backfilled, is not in the UI, and --partition <it> fails with DagsterUnknownPartitionError before any work starts. Stronger than not selecting it, and it is what stops a backfill taking everything. NOTE the one asymmetry: absent-inside-a-listed-owner is OFF, but an owner mentioned NOWHERE is 'no opinion' and keeps all its partitions -- otherwise raw/cafef_pdfs' 100 unlisted tickers would resolve to zero partitions and raise at import.
// PARTITION OWNERS: The key under `partitions` is the partition set's OWNER, which is not always an asset. Assets sharing one PartitionsDefinition share its toggles: `raw/trading_view` covers trading_view_links AND trading_view_data (the data step reads the link CSV its own partition wrote, so they cannot disagree), and `unified` covers all four pool__* assets. Sets owned by a single asset keep that asset's key: raw/cafef_pdfs, raw/cafef_financials. Owners not listed here have every partition enabled.
// YOU CANNOT DISABLE THEM ALL: If every partition of one owner is false the load RAISES: an asset with zero partitions is unmaterializable in a way that reads as a Dagster bug. To switch the whole thing off, use its `assets` key.

assets.// ---- trading_view ----: TRADINGVIEW - the universe (links) then the OHLCV (data). 9 asset-class partitions; see `partitions` for which are on.

trading_view.// enabled: ON. The only group enabled. `enabled` gates the whole group: with it false, every asset below is off however it is set.
trading_view.// raw/trading_view_collected_links: nothing reads this - an aggregation leaf, off so it cannot be swept into a selection

assets.// ---- cafef ----: CAFEF - the five per-stock daily/event tabs plus the news feed. Every one needs raw/trading_view_links partition `stocks`.

cafef.// enabled: OFF - needs raw/trading_view_links partition `stocks`, which is also off.
cafef.// raw/cafef_news: HEAVY - ~2 h, ~405k rows over the full universe

assets.// ---- cafef_index ----: CAFEF MARKET INDICES - the same four tabs over 6 fixed index codes. No upstream, minutes to run.

cafef_index.// enabled: OFF - independent of TradingView, minutes to run when wanted.

assets.// ---- cafef_filings ----: CAFEF FILINGS - PDF archive then the OCR statement parse. Both partitioned per ticker; ~1-1.7 GB and ~2.4 h EACH.

cafef_filings.// enabled: OFF - ~1-1.7 GB and ~2.4 h PER TICKER.

assets.// ---- simplize ----: SIMPLIZE - the fully dividend-adjusted daily panel and the industry map.
assets.// ---- gics ----: GICS - MSCI's reference taxonomy. No upstream.
assets.// ---- bronze ----: BRONZE TABLES - raw_data/ -> bronze_schema. 20 ingest leaves, 25 tables. Each reads its own folder; no cross-table dependency.

bronze.// enabled: OFF - turn on bronze/trading_view_economy (and this gate) once the economy CSVs are on disk.
bronze.// bronze/cafef_financials: writes SIX tables from one ingest
bronze.// bronze/simplize_stocks: 2.7 M rows - the biggest table in the layer

assets.// ---- silver ----: SILVER TABLES - bronze_schema -> silver_schema. The canonical long facts, dimensions and joined panels.

silver.// silver/cafef_financials: ONE method, THREE tables - the per-report statement carry-ups
silver.// silver/cafef_financials_bank: the 3 bank statements carried up, then joined wide per quarter (180 cols)
silver.// silver/stocks_basic_financials_bank: daily x quarterly, as-of on publish_date - INNER, bank tickers only
silver.// silver/cafef_news: 395k articles cleaned + de-duped + ALIGNED TO A SESSION (trading_date is the look-ahead guard); needs silver/stocks_basic for the calendar

assets.// ---- gold ----: GOLD TABLES - silver_schema -> gold_schema. The wide, model-ready panels; every densifying assumption lives here.

gold.// gold/economy: WIDE: 1 row per business day, 1 col per series, as-of filled
gold.// gold/bonds: 9 tenors x 13 measures = 117 cols; the VN01/VN01Y twins are asserted identical, then collapsed
gold.// gold/funds: 19 HOSE ETFs x up to 19 measures = 351 cols; replaces the long 22-col feature table
gold.// gold/forex: 328 broker-quoted pairs, ONE value column each = 328 cols; no features (328 x 13 would exceed PostgreSQL's 1600-column ceiling)
gold.// gold/stocks: The per-stock price/flow panel, ~2.4M stock-days x ~42 cols, adjusted OHLC, NO derived columns
gold.// gold/stocks_ta: HEAVY - gold/stocks + the ~900-column TA block over 2.4M rows: hours, ~11 GB
gold.// gold/stocks_financials_bank_fa: FEATURE panel: the _fa source + the full TA battery, ~1.1k columns
gold.// gold/news_weekly_panel: 497k ticker-WEEKS, news + event counts, no sentiment - the panel the if_news baseline runs on
gold.// gold/news_daily_panel: DAILY twin of the weekly panel - trailing 5/10-session news windows for rel5/rel10

assets.// ---- unified ----: UNIFIED TABLES - silver_schema -> unified_schema_<universe>. One universe per partition, cut into feature groups.

unified.// enabled: OFF - nothing here reads the economy chain.
unified.// unified/pool__basic: every column of silver.stocks_basic for the partition's universe, silver's own types
unified.// unified/pool__targets: return_{5,10}day + return_rel_{5,10}day (minus the VNINDEX return over the same window)
unified.// unified/pool__ta: HEAVY on ALL - ~920 technical columns from gold.stocks_ta
unified.// unified/pool__fa: ~204 fundamental columns from gold.stocks_financials_bank_fa - BANK TICKERS ONLY by construction

partitions.// raw/trading_view: THE NINE TRADINGVIEW SCRAPE MODULES, all listed so the menu is the whole menu. ONLY `economy` IS ON (2026-08-05). A false one is not merely unselected - it is gone from the PartitionsDefinition, so a backfill cannot reach it and --partition <it> fails before any work starts.

raw/trading_view.// economy: ON - 19 countries x 11 categories = 209 link leaves, ~3,850 series. The only module currently enabled.
raw/trading_view.// forex: the big one - 2,184 symbols across 47 brokers, ~7-8 h at 4 browsers
raw/trading_view.// stocks: HEAVY - 777 tickers. Also the UNIVERSE every CafeF/Simplize asset reads (links/stocks/), so turn it on before re-scraping those.
raw/trading_view.// futures: vietnam only; every leaf has been empty since June
raw/trading_view.// indices: 50 symbols; gold.indices was retired 2026-08-01, gold/stock_market covers the same six from CafeF at 27 measures
raw/trading_view.// crypto: queues 0 tasks - no children in switch_config.json, and its DATA adder is a stub
raw/trading_view.// options: queues 0 tasks; its data adder takes no skip_existing argument, so the partition raises if run

partitions.// raw/cafef_financials: The two tickers whose PDFs are OCR-parsed. Listed for completeness; the asset itself is false under `assets`.
partitions.// unified: The three universes of the unified schema, shared by all four pool__* assets.
partitions.// raw/cafef_pdfs: 100 ticker partitions from vn100.csv, NOT listed here - absent means enabled, and 100 lines of `true` would bury the settings that matter. Disable one with "raw/cafef_pdfs": {"HOSE_VCB": false}.

run.// skip_existing: FALSE re-fetches every symbol (a real refresh). TRUE fetches only symbols absent from disk - right for RESUMING an interrupted run, wrong for refreshing.
run.// max_browsers: Hard cap on concurrent Chrome instances; also sizes the scraper's thread pool, so this IS the number of browsers. Overridable per shell with $env:SCRAPER_MAX_CONCURRENT_BROWSERS.
